_comment: Printed keyword GoAgain would fire unconditionally from the card DB; this WHILE_STATIC gated on SOURCE_IS_ATTACK + PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL makes it conditional. loader.conditional_keywords() suppresses the printed keyword when it finds a SOURCE_IS_ATTACK-gated grant of the same keyword. The card is a Lightning Action - Attack; when played from arsenal it becomes the active attack, SOURCE_IS_ATTACK is true, and PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL reads the played_from_zone stamp.
